# Best MagSafe car mounts (Qi2)

I can't browse, so I don't have direct product-page links. Where I could, I've linked the review pages that carry the buy buttons.

## Top picks

**Best for most iPhone owners: Belkin BoostCharge Qi2 15W Vent Mount (~$47.99)**
- Includes a 1 m USB-C cable and a 27W car adapter, rotates between portrait and landscape, and takes cases up to 3 mm thick.
- Check your vents first. Belkin's specs say slats should be no more than 3 mm thick and 20 mm deep. Vertical or shallow slats can droop.
- There is also a vent/dash version for awkward vents.
- Sources: [RottenWiFi](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/), [iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/), [CloudsPress](https://www.cloudspress.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/)

**Fastest and most reliable: Anker Prime MagGo AirCool, Qi2 25W (A2933), $89.99 list**
- It has active cooling (thermoelectric plus a fan) to prevent heat throttling, and The Gadgeteer lists it at $69.99 on sale.
- Only iPhone 16 Pro Max/16 Plus/17 reach 25W. The iPhone 16 and 16 Pro get up to 22W, and iPhone 15 and earlier get about 15W.
- It doesn't work with Tesla or Mercedes-Benz vents, or vehicles without standard vent blades.
- Reviews disagree on the adapter. MountGuys and The Gadgeteer say a 60W adapter is in the box, while the other reviews say you need your own 45W+ adapter. Confirm on the listing.
- Sources: [MountGuys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/) (their daily driver), [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/)

**Best value with a fan: ESR HaloLock 15W with CryoBoost**
- It is Qi2 certified, with a fan to reduce throttling, and mounts on a vent or the dash.
- Prices vary by source: $18.99 on The Gadgeteer, and $39.99 at ESR's store. ESR code PARTNER18 takes it to $32.80 through Dec 31, 2026.
- A car adapter may not be included, so budget $10–15 more.
- [Buy at ESR](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost). This is an affiliate link, and Dealectric earns a commission at no cost to you.

## Other options
- **Cheap, dash or vent: LISEN 15W (~$15.99 on Amazon).** It has 24 magnets and dual mounting, but it is less vetted. It needs a charger that supplies at least 18W per port. See the buy buttons on [RottenWiFi](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/).
- **25W with a fan: LISEN Qi2.2 (from $39.95).** It ships with a 95W adapter, per [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/).
- **No charging, sturdiest vent hold: VICSEED steel-core vent mount.** MountGuys picked it from research, not hands-on testing. [MountGuys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/)

## Quick tips
- Look for a **Qi2 certification**. "MagSafe-compatible" alone may mean only 7.5W.
- To get the advertised wattage, you need a strong enough USB-C car adapter.
- Ignore the "80 lb suction" claims, since they describe the suction base rather than the magnet hold.

If you tell me your phone model and whether your car has horizontal vents, I can narrow it to one pick.
